episodes.title: A Princess, an Elf, and a Demon Walk Into a Bar
episodes.summary: Princess Bean already has the wedding day blues when a mysterious figure arrives, claiming he's her personal demon. Elfo hates his happy homeland.

episodes.title: For Whom the Pig Oinks
episodes.summary: How to get rid of an unwanted fiancé? Bean's plan involves a party barge and mermaids. King Zøg tries to make Elfo's blood into an immortality potion.

episodes.title: The Princess of Darkness
episodes.summary: Sorcerio declares that demonic possession is behind Bean's drunken exploits -- and things look dicey for Luci when the king hires an eerie exorcist.

episodes.title: Castle Party Massacre
episodes.summary: With the king away, Bean throws a wild party while Odval and Sorcerio gather their secret society for a ritual. But the night takes a surprising turn.

episodes.title: Faster, Princess! Kill! Kill!
episodes.summary: Banished from the castle by Zøg, Bean tries to work but has trouble keeping a job. Elfo encounters a bizarre pair of siblings living in a candy house.

episodes.title: Swamp and Circumstance
episodes.summary: Bean tries her hand at diplomacy after Zøg makes her ambassador to Dankmire, Oona's kingdom and an important ally for Dreamland.

episodes.title: Love's Tender Rampage
episodes.summary: Elfo lies to hide his feelings for Bean, but things get complicated when she tries to help him by sending the knights on a quest.

episodes.title: The Limits of Immortality
episodes.summary: Elfo's been kidnapped! Bean, Luci, Sorcerio and the knights search for him, along with a magical pendant needed to complete the immortality potion.

episodes.title: To Thine Own Elf Be True
episodes.summary: After he learns a surprising secret about himself, Elfo heads home to Elfwood in search of the truth.

episodes.title: Dreamland Falls
episodes.summary: As Dreamland celebrates an unexpected arrival while saying goodbye to a friend, everyday life is thrown into disarray.

episodes.title: The Disenchantress
episodes.summary: Bean travels with Dagmar to her homeland, Maru, where she rescues an old friend and learns of a mysterious prophecy she's expected to fulfill.

episodes.title: Stairway to Hell
episodes.summary: Bean and Luci concoct a plan to resurrect Elfo. But he'll have to meet them in hell -- if he can get there. Zøg discovers a friend in frozen Dreamland.

episodes.title: The Very Thing
episodes.summary: Bean and her friends return to Dreamland but don't receive a warm welcome from Zøg. Oona inspires a lackluster band of pirates who rescue her at sea.

episodes.title: The Lonely Heart Is a Hunter
episodes.summary: Bean dreams about her mother and finds mystical Maruvian symbols around the castle. Zøg falls for an unusual woman he meets in the Enchanted Forest.

episodes.title: Our Bodies, Our Elves
episodes.summary: With a health crisis in Elf Alley, Bean and Elfo make a dangerous journey to find an ancient cure while Luci scams sick elves at his new clinic.

episodes.title: The Dreamland Job
episodes.summary: Learning that the elves are starving because of Zøg's excessive taxes, Bean plans a heist with a passing band of circus performers to recover the money.

episodes.title: Love's Slimy Embrace
episodes.summary: Despondent because Bean dislikes him and his mother's away, Derek makes friends with a slimy sea creature. Zøg tries to contract a rich man's disease.

episodes.title: In Her Own Write
episodes.summary: While Zøg refuses to face his feelings about Dagmar's betrayal, Bean writes to deal with her pain. But she faces obstacles to sharing her work.

episodes.title: The Electric Princess
episodes.summary: When a scientific man appears in Dreamland, he's regarded with suspicion. But Bean helps him escape and travels with him to a wondrous steampunk city.

episodes.title: Tiabeanie Falls
episodes.summary: With King Zøg incapacitated, Odval makes a power play, assisted by the Arch Druidess. Luci and Elfo try to help Bean.

episodes.title: Subterranean Homesick Blues
episodes.summary: Bean, Elfo and Luci become trapped in an underground world full of eerie little creatures — and Queen Dagmar. Zøg tries to thwart a plot against him.

episodes.title: You're the Bean
episodes.summary: As Zøg attempts to escape a harrowing situation, Derek discovers a book that implies his family is cursed. Bean hatches a plan to escape from Trøgtown.

episodes.title: Beanie Get Your Gun
episodes.summary: Zøg's acting strange, and Bean investigates to learn why. Meanwhile, a despondent Derek finds some surprising mentors in the Enchanted Forest.

episodes.title: Steamland Confidential
episodes.summary: After traveling to Steamland, Elfo enthralls the denizens of an upscale explorers' club while Bean infiltrates a factory in search of the Arch Druidess.

episodes.title: Freak Out!
episodes.summary: Bean flees when she discovers more about Alva's intentions — and as his lightbulb-headed robots chase her through Steamland, she searches for Elfo.

episodes.title: Last Splash
episodes.summary: On their return trip to Dreamland via steamboat, lovelorn Elfo winds up in an unusual relationship while Bean gets close to Mora the mermaid.

episodes.title: Bad Moon Rising
episodes.summary: Bean overhears Odval and the council plotting against Zøg, so she joins forces with Oona to undermine their plan while Elfo and Luci raise an army.

episodes.title: Hey, Pig Spender
episodes.summary: After trying to help Prince Merkimer lift the curse that turned him into a pig, Bean asks his parents for resources to thwart the threat from Steamland.

episodes.title: The Madness of King Zøg
episodes.summary: As a mysterious cloud of green smoke moves toward Dreamland and Zøg becomes more unstable than ever, Bean finds a unique way to communicate with him.

episodes.title: Bean Falls Down
episodes.summary: Bean's having a stressful day! First, an old nemesis arrives, acting suspiciously contrite. Then, vicious ogres invade and won't leave without Elfo.

episodes.title: Love Is Hell
episodes.summary: In hell, Bean resists Dagmar's attempts to force her to marry Satan. Meanwhile, Luci plots to flee heaven and Elfo tries to escape from the ogres.

episodes.title: The Good, The Bad, and the Bum-Bum
episodes.summary: Bean, Jerry and Luci commandeer an airship from Alva. Held captive by the ogres, Elfo discovers an entire family history he knew nothing about.

episodes.title: The Cabinet of Dr. Chazzzzz
episodes.summary: Zøg is institutionalized with Chazzzzz, while Vip and Vap launch an epic rescue. Bean doesn't get the warm reception she expects at Dreamland.

episodes.title: Goon Baby Goon
episodes.summary: Bean and her friends are reunited with Zøg and discover that Becky and Cloyd have seized Dreamland, secretly transforming its citizens into goons.

episodes.title: The Pitter-Patter of Little Feet
episodes.summary: After Sorcerio brings Freckles to life, the wooden puppet sets out to undermine Zøg with a comedy roast and an alliance with Becky and Cloyd.

episodes.title: What to Expect When You're Expecting Parasites
episodes.summary: Zøg, Bean and her friends plunge into the ocean, where they find a submerged castle inhabited by Sea Trøgs guarding a treasure linked to the Elves.

episodes.title: The Unbearable Lightning of Bean
episodes.summary: Lonely Zøg searches the forest for his true love, Ursula the Bear, who's got a secret. Elfo, Luci and Bean stumble upon the site of an ancient battle.

episodes.title: Spy Vs. Spy Vs. Spy
episodes.summary: Ordered to spy on the elves, Elfo is captured and forced to spy on the Trøgs — who see through his disguise and return him to spy on the humans.

episodes.title: The Goo-Bye Girl
episodes.summary: Freckles manipulates Derek and Bear Boy into confronting some bullies. The secret of the goo is out but who will drink it to become the savior?

episodes.title: Bean Falls Apart
episodes.summary: In her dreams, Bean confronts her inner "Bad Bean", but the evil doppelgänger conceals a sinister plot. Derek, Bear Boy and Freckles get captured.

episodes.title: Heads or Tails
episodes.summary: Queen Dagmar interrogates the Dreamland townsfolk to find out who's hiding Bean's body. Meanwhile, Luci reconnects with his estranged father.

episodes.title: Fish Out of Water
episodes.summary: While Bean and the crew try to find a place to dispose of the body, King Zøg battles cops, robots and an angry mob to rescue his three sons.

episodes.title: Electric Ladyland
episodes.summary: After Malfus foretells an ominous prophecy, Bean and Mora travel to Steamland to reconnect with Zøg — but first they must decode a cryptic message.

episodes.title: I Hear Your Noggin, But You Can't Come In
episodes.summary: Zøg, Bean and Mora search for a way into the Freak Show to free Derek, Bear Boy and Freckles. Then, Elfo and the crew elude a persistent Bad Bean.

episodes.title: Who Shot Elfo?
episodes.summary: Tormented by the mystery of his death, Elfo takes an ill-advised trip to figure out who shot him. Meanwhile, Luci hides Bad Bean's head from Satan.

episodes.title: The Stience of Homemade Lightning
episodes.summary: In the forgotten city of Maru, Bean meets the Queen of the Crones, who encourages her to harness her new special power. Later, Elfo falls for a friend.

episodes.title: Gimme Gimme Shock Treatment
episodes.summary: As the townsfolk prepare for war, Bean and Zøg land in the Twinkletown Asylum, where the princess makes a stunning realization about her destiny.

episodes.title: The Battle of Falling Water
episodes.summary: A battle between the Dreamland army and Dagmar's forces may spell disaster for Princess Bean, unless she can defeat her greatest foe: herself.

episodes.title: Darkness Falls
episodes.summary: With the Crystal Caverns magic flowing throughout the kingdom, only Bean can stop power from falling into the wrong hands — if she can quit moping first.

episodes.title: Goodbye Bean
episodes.summary: With the fate of Dreamland hanging in the balance, a mother battles her daughter for beauty, power and immortality. But living forever comes at a price.
